scope: nested multi-timeframe structure conditions only - this is NOT the full library scan
note: Floor-free census. Every generated (base, arm, symbol, tf-pair) combination is stored, including the ones that never traded and the ones that lost money. 1890 rows. Per-row session/regime/volatility breakdowns are retained only for rows with at least 20 trades in that period; below that they are single-trade buckets.
